edges.description: Loss of the co-receptor lowers BMP/SMAD output in the cells that build cartilage and bone. Two independent lines make this edge rather than the nodes alone: knocking SCUBE3 down in human bone-marrow mesenchymal stem cells blocks osteogenic differentiation, and the disease-associated alleles themselves reduce SMAD transactivation in vitro.

edges.description: Reproduces impaired BMP-mediated chondrogenesis and osteogenesis with craniofacial, dental and endochondral bone abnormalities and decreased body size.
edges.limitations: Much milder than the human disorder: the null mouse is viable and fertile with no overt embryonic phenotype, which the authors attribute to functional redundancy with other Scube family members. Mouse Scube3 also does not affect the hedgehog pathway, unlike zebrafish scube3, so cross-species inference about SCUBE pathway roles is unsafe.

edges.description: Reproduces the axial skeletal arm - severe spine deformity, skeletal abnormalities and altered bone metabolism - and links the disease alleles to reduced SMAD transactivation.
edges.limitations: An ENU-induced missense allele (C301Y) rather than a null, and one not seen in a patient, so severity cannot be read across to the human loss-of-function alleles. It is a cbEGF7 substitution like N294K and is predicted to break a conserved disulfide bond, which is what makes it comparable to the human missense spectrum. The model was ascertained on spine deformity, so the craniofacial and dental domains that define the human syndrome are not reported for it.
edges.source: Scube3 ENU mutant mouse (saturation mutagenesis screen)

edges.description: Produces skeletal morphological abnormalities and altered bone-metabolism parameters, and its allele's receptor-binding defect is characterized.
edges.limitations: N294K is a mouse ENU allele rather than a variant seen in a patient, so the correspondence to the human disease runs through the affected domain (cbEGF7) and the demonstrated loss of BMP type IA receptor binding, not through the genotype. Being a single missense allele, it also says nothing about the frameshift, nonsense and splice-site variants that make up much of the human variant spectrum. The published phenotyping is a broad screening panel rather than a targeted skeletal study, and the paper frames the bone findings against Paget disease of bone rather than against this syndrome, which did not yet exist as an entity when it was written.

nodes.description:
The dental arm of the mechanism, which is separable from the bone arm rather than a restatement of it. Scube3 transcript in the developing tooth is epithelial, and the protein moves to the mesenchyme, so the defect is in an epithelial-to-mesenchymal instruction: without it, dental mesenchymal cells fail to differentiate into polarized odontoblasts. The epithelial side is affected too - Scube3 knockout ameloblasts are shorter and wider and lose their Tomes processes; ameloblasts are epithelial rather than the mesenchyme-derived odontoblasts this node is bound to, and are recorded here because ameloblast induction is a prerequisite for odontoblast differentiation. This is why dental anomalies are prominent enough to appear in the disorder's ISDS row rather than being an incidental finding.

One caveat on how much this node claims. Nothing has been measured in SCUBE3-deficient human or mouse teeth at the odontoblast level: the Scube3 knockout reports dental defects clinically, and the odontoblast step is a sufficiency result in healthy cells read in reverse. The DECREASED modifiers on the two GO processes are therefore an inference from the direction of those experiments rather than a measured reduction.

nodes.description: Biallelic inactivating SCUBE3 variants remove a membrane-associated BMP2/4 co-receptor. Wild-type SCUBE3 attracts BMP receptor complexes to lipid-raft microdomains and enhances BMP signalling, apparently by facilitating the interaction of BMP ligands with BMP type I receptors. The best-characterized illustration of what that loss costs at the protein level is the N294K substitution, which reaches the cell surface normally but fails to complex with BMP type IA receptor - so the defect is in receptor engagement, not in protein trafficking. Read that as mechanism rather than as a patient variant: N294K is a mouse ENU-induced allele and is not among the human variants this entry curates. It is informative here because it sits in the cbEGF7 calcium-binding repeat, the same module the human missense alleles disrupt.

nodes.description: What separates this model from the other two is that its allele is characterized down to the protein interaction: N294K reaches the cell surface but fails to complex with BMP type IA receptor, so the mouse demonstrates the exact molecular step the trigger node asserts is lost. It is a domain match rather than an allele match, and the difference matters - N294K is an ENU-induced mouse allele, not a variant reported in a patient, but it falls in the cbEGF7 calcium-binding repeat, where several of the human missense alleles cluster. The line also arrived the other way round from most disease models: it was recovered from a morphological screen in the Munich ENU programme in 2016, four years before the human syndrome was described, so nobody chose this substitution to match a patient. Two of its findings sit outside what this entry curates as human phenotypes - hearing impairment and altered renal function. Neither is curated as a disease feature, because no cached source states either in patients; a deep-research report does describe recurrent conductive hearing loss in the discovery cohort, which this entry cannot quote. They are recorded here as model findings.
